claims.sentence: After you are enrolled, the University assigns you an identifier (personal login) and provides a primary password
You use the standard identification level to access the University's EIS
Enter your identifier (login) and password to gain access to all data and the specific modules assigned to you in the system
The platform provides remote access to modern professional databases and information reference systems
The specific composition of these databases and systems is determined in the working programs of disciplines (modules) and is updated if necessary

You can access study plans, working programs of disciplines (modules), practices, electronic educational publications, and electronic educational resources that are specified in those working programs
The system supports the formation of your electronic portfolio, including the saving of your works and grades for those works
It records the course of the educational process, the results of intermediate certification, and the results of mastering educational programs
You can use the platform to conduct educational sessions and assessment procedures that are provided for using electronic learning and distance educational technologies
The system enables interaction between participants of the educational process, including synchronous and asynchronous interaction via the Internet
The evidence does not specify how to change the primary password after first login
It does not provide direct links, URLs, or technical support contacts for the platform
It does not state what happens if the identifier or password is lost or compromised
It does not list the exact professional databases or information reference systems available, only that they are defined in the working programs of disciplines (modules)
It does not explain how to access the platform from outside the university network beyond stating that remote access is provided
